findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "jobs_search" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jobs_search · Private data: jobs_search · Public sink: jobs_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jobs_search · Private data: jobs_search · Public sink: jobs_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
